data.one_liner: Experimental 3D support for the Flame Game Engine using Flutter GPU.
data.what_it_does: Adds experimental 3D rendering and object capabilities to the Flame game engine. It utilizes Flutter GPU and Impeller to provide a familiar API for Flame developers wanting to explore 3D features.
use_when: You are building a game with Flame and want to experiment with 3D graphics
You are targeting Android, iOS, or macOS with Impeller enabled
avoid_when: You are building for production environments (APIs are unstable)
You require stable semantic versioning or fully documented 3D production tooling
strengths: Integrates directly into the Flame engine ecosystem
Provides a familiar API for existing Flame developers
Supports custom shaders and bundled materials
weaknesses: Experimental package with potential breaking changes and lack of semver compliance
Requires very recent Flutter versions (3.47.0 or newer)
Limited documentation and testing due to rapid changes
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.47.0+ and enabling Impeller and Flutter GPU in platform configuration (e.g., Info.plist). Web usage requires explicit GpuBackend initialization.

alternatives.name: flame
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want stable 2D game development without experimental 3D requirements.

alternatives.name: three_js
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a more established 3D library port in Dart.
